name: Sono Kojou ni Yuusha Hou Ari!
original_name: その古城に勇者砲あり！
source:
The hero Oura arrived at an old castle on his journey to defeat the demon king. By chance, he discovered an ancient super-weapon called the ‘hero cannon’ (yuusha-hou), which only activates after having sex with girls! Together with the failure succubus Tina, envious osananajimi and healer Flare, overly serious royal knight Mira, and selfish magician Ekuri, Oura’s ecchi battle begins!

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/12/18/december-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
英雄大浦在讨伐魔王的旅途中来到了一座古老的城堡。一次偶然的机会，他发现了一种古老的超级武器，名为“英雄炮”（yuusha-hou），只有在与女孩发生性关系后才会激活！失败的魅魔蒂娜、嫉妒的奥萨娜娜吉米和治愈者芙蕾尔、过于严肃的皇家骑士米拉、自私的魔法师艾久里，大浦的恶狼之战开始了！

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/12/18/december-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
